PokeU_Cottage.title: Cottage
PokeU_Cottage.drawn: Three copies of the cottage: a steep gable roof of red tiles with its ridge front to back; a timber frame at the front, posts standing out from the corners under a beam across it, the gable over it dark between a post under the ridge and two braces, two windows in it; cream walls; the red door with a window, two windows of two panes with flower boxes; two beige chimney stacks on the right slope.

PokeU_WingHouse.title: Wing house
PokeU_WingHouse.drawn: The big house at the right: a wing on the right a tile ahead of the rest under a gable roof of red tiles with its ridge front to back, its gable dark with a window of two panes over a beam on timber posts; the part to its left under a lean-to of red tiles, hipped at its left end, over a beam on a timber post, with the red door and a small window with a flower box; a window with a flower box in the wing (the rest of its front hidden by a tree); two beige chimney stacks on the wing's right slope.
